card.name: Final digit in number ranges
card.fires_on: A single digit that ends or nearly ends a multi-digit number in a table range or citation, such as the 2 in 32 or the 6 in 1936 after a dash, 'to' or slash.

modes.label: Range tables
modes.description: Last digit of the second number in a dose or weight range written with 'to' or a dash.

modes.label: Years in citations
modes.description: Third digit of a year in a book reference after a slash.
modes.example: J. H. Randall; (1899-1980); Philosophy: An Introduction; 1942/19<<5>>7; p137 The

modes.label: Reference numbers
modes.description: Final digit of a second reference number after a comma.
